pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Bind the detonator to an eligible explosive. Craft the siren from Brainiac Charred Remnants; it warns of nearby nuclear explosions. Respect protection rules; ordinary permitted TNT is enough for the detonator.

pages.title: Practical note
pages.text: Hear an actual Nuclear Siren warning and remotely activate a permitted explosive. Bind the detonator to an eligible explosive. Craft the siren from Brainiac Charred Remnants; it warns of nearby nuclear explosions. Respect protection rules; ordinary permitted TNT is enough for the detonator.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Fuel a Raygun with a Uranium Rod and deal positive beam damage to a hostile creature. Defeat a Nucleeper before its charge completes to obtain a Fissile Core. The gun uses polymer and Uranium Rods. Its beam damages along its path; siren/Hazmat do not replace safety rules.
